description: Metadata for public Finnish Center for Artificial Intelligence research, news, program, and publication HTML pages on fcai.fi and www.fcai.fi. Each stored URL was one bounded GET that returned HTML on those hosts. Challenges, captchas, authentication walls, non-HTML shells, robots disallows, and off-host redirects are omitted. Rows store title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page text, abstracts, quotes, transcripts, PDFs, and chart data are not stored. creative_commons_attribution is CC BY alone. creative_commons is CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix of those. A sole restricted deed keeps its token. Missing dates stay unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. Not a belief collector. runner_wired is false.
